Two things you should look at:

One is my own summary text, posted to #north-team as ts 1791986400.000125. The other is in #north-random as ts 1791986400.000128, and it says I saved the correction to the gbrain brain. I did not do that in this session. Someone or something else posted or saved these, so please check where they came from.
- **Brain entry:** The 100-seat fact in the brain is marked as saved on 30 Oct. I did not write it, and I did not change it.
